A prefix implying ‘badness’, ‘deterioration’, ‘depreciation’,
 ‘sin’, ‘reproach’, ‘littleness’, ‘want’, ‘deficiency’, &c. Its various
 substitutes are कद् (कदश्व), कव (कवोष्ण), का
 (कोष्ण), किं (किंप्रभुः); cf.
